{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.659
    | text      = On Monday, the onion announced for the second time that they bought Info Wars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.659
    | text      = This time seems a little bit more officially.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.659
    | text      = Maybe I have a lot of complicated feelings about this turn of events, but I want to sum
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:58.299
    | text      = it up as succinctly as possible by saying, I hope it all works out and that there's a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.179
    | text      = positive net effect.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:03.980
    | text      = I think that a lot of people want a little bit more than that from me or us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:07.899
    | text      = So here goes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.820
    | text      = I think the onion has an incredibly talented writing team and competent leadership and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.799
    | text      = that Tim Heidecker is exactly the kind of performer who can pull off layered and biting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.440
    | text      = satire.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.580
    | text      = If anyone should be the person picked to try and make a parody of Info Wars, he's definitely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.259
    | text      = the guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:25.259
    | text      = And I think that some strong comedic talent is going to be involved and some content will
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.620
    | text      = come out of this that probably will rule.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.820
    | text      = But for me, the issue is that I don't think anyone should do this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:37.100
    | text      = Info Wars isn't really satirizable in a meaningful way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.340
    | text      = The content is absurd to the point where anyone trying to create a fake version of it will
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:44.379
    | text      = only succeed at making something that's kind of close to the regular version.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:49.580
    | text      = Alex drunkenly throwing hatchets around the studio or telling Chase that he thinks he's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.259
    | text      = about to call in the Angel of Death or Alex sincerely talking about how he ran into some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.860
    | text      = really tall vampires in DC or the orbs that are coming on Easter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:03.179
    | text      = That's all content that should be in a parody of Info Wars, but it's actually just what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.419
    | text      = the show is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.120
    | text      = So I think that there's a challenge that pulling off a satire of this presents that I sincerely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.740
    | text      = hope that they can do something with, but I don't know if anyone can.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.539
    | text      = That's really where the heart of my sort of weird feelings about this live.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:29.100
    | text      = If you parody something that is itself a parody, you kind of help the original thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.100
    | text      = And I don't know how you get around that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.500
    | text      = It may be that it's possible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:40.080
    | text      = It might be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:41.080
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:42.080
    | text      = I mean, it sucks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.080
    | text      = If I'm allowed to talk about the way I feel, bad things are going to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:49.019
    | text      = So I'm just going to let it go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.019
    | text      = Well, you could say a few things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.620
    | text      = I have things to say.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.019
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:54.019
    | text      = Best of luck to everybody involved.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:58.700
    | text      = Never speak to me about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.700
    | text      = We were talking a little bit before the show, and I think it's safe to say that you have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:03.139
    | text      = a lot more of a pessimistic outlook than I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.299
    | text      = And my outlook isn't super optimistic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:08.340
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.340
    | text      = I don't want to shit on something before it even exists or say, hey, this is a horrible
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.419
    | text      = mistake.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.419
    | text      = But I don't know exactly how you walk this line.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:21.860
    | text      = And one of the reasons that we talked about was because if you're making a parody of Infowars,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:29.340
    | text      = you have to be making it for an audience who is in on the joke.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:33.879
    | text      = And most people have no idea what Infowars really is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:37.080
    | text      = They don't know he's talking about calling in the angel of death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.740
    | text      = They don't know this stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:41.899
    | text      = They see a meme of him talking about gay frogs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:45.100
    | text      = That's the extent of the awareness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:46.100
    | text      = A boney bear cover.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.379
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:48.379
    | text      = That's the extent of the awareness that most people have of what his show is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.299
    | text      = So if you're making a parody of it, you have to parody that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:55.860
    | text      = And that's not really who he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:58.299
    | text      = That's part of who he is, but it's not really.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.240
    | text      = You have to parody an effigy, a picture of Alex as opposed to who he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.659
    | text      = And I don't know if there's a way to do a parody that's not that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:15.259
    | text      = Because how would...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.399
    | text      = If you said in a joke article on their new site, if you were to say, Alex tearfully calls
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:28.019
    | text      = in the angel of death to take out Biden or whatever, that looks like a pretty fucking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:33.240
    | text      = funny headline if you don't watch Alex's show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.360
    | text      = But it's actually just what he did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:36.360
    | text      = It's just a regular thing he said.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.460
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.460
    | text      = I might...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.460
    | text      = I'll say this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:43.460
    | text      = InfoWars exists on its own continuum.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.820
    | text      = There is InfoWars and there is not InfoWars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.139
    | text      = On the continuum is just levels of quality of InfoWars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:54.179
    | text      = Anything you make that is InfoWars is just either InfoWars better or InfoWars worse
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = or InfoWars the same.

    | timestamp = 00:13:01.759

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = I don't think that there's anything wrong with taking away his shit.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I think, great.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = is to be a hero like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:27.960
    | text      = Someone who lives on in the lore of future Patriots.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
